payload.friendly_name: troupe configuration: keep shared includes shared
payload.purpose_context: Included YAML files are shared between projects. Step 5 (CR-A) introduces mapping-form includes ($ref plus override keys, deep-merged) and changes set so that new keys under an included section become overrides in the including file, while existing settings are still changed where they live.
payload.purpose_tldr: Adding a new setting under an included section writes an override in the including file instead of modifying the shared include.

options: The file holding the nearest include reference (a.yaml), as the contract literally says
The root file (never touch any included file)
payload.question: When the new key's deepest existing ancestor comes from an include nested inside another include (root -> a.yaml -> b.yaml), which file receives the override?

payload.final_answer: The file holding the nearest include reference (a.yaml), as the contract literally says

options: Exit 4 naming the file (cannot be loaded)
Treat it as an ordinary mapping with a literal $ref key
payload.question: A mapping has a $ref key whose value is not an include string (e.g. $ref: 5, $ref: agents/coder.yaml without file:). What happens?

payload.final_answer: Out of contract; agent choice: exit 4 naming the file and the $ref path. Conservative (TROUPE-002): a malformed include is never silently treated as data and set never writes overrides against a non-include.

options: Flag ignored: the override is changed, as without the flag
Change the value in the included file (override still wins, no visible effect)
payload.question: set --in-include on an existing value that is overridden in the including file: what happens?

payload.rationale: Contract answers it: In-include governs only new keys; Overrides says an existing overridden value changes the override. --in-include has no effect on existing values.

payload.question: Approve the engineering alignment: merged-view tree (MergedMapping subclass of MappingNode, YamlInclude.holder), one placement module deciding override vs step-1 target, verification extended for scalar->mapping-form conversion, plus spec additions D-10 (replacing a merged collection exits 3), D-11 (multi-line include string conversion exits 3) and the D-7 fix (empty target stays an empty mapping)?

payload.final_answer: Approve. Spec additions D-7 correction, D-10, D-11 are out-of-contract agent choices, recorded in the spec with reasons.
